high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Jing Daily, a publication focused on the luxury business in China. The headline reads, "Meet the digital fashion disruptor revolutionizing traditional Chinese wear," authored by Bethanie Ryder and published on October 6, 2023. The main subject of the image is a person standing outdoors in front of a modern building with large glass windows. The individual is wearing a unique outfit that blends traditional Chinese elements with contemporary design.
